logger.doc:name: Log Processing Start
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_PROCESSING_STARTED", triggerType: vars.triggerType, runId: vars.runId, sourceFilePath: vars.sourceFilePath, businessDate: vars.businessDate, targetDirectory: vars.targetDirectory, rejectedTargetDirectory: vars.rejectedTargetDirectory, validStagingDirectory: vars.validStagingDirectory, rejectedStagingDirectory: vars.rejectedStagingDirectory }]

logger.doc:name: Log Source File Available
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_SOURCE_FILE_AVAILABLE", triggerType: vars.triggerType, runId: vars.runId, sourceFilePath: vars.sourceFilePath, sourceFileName: vars.expectedSourceFileName, runStatus: vars.runStatus, checkedAt: (now() >> "Asia/Kolkata") as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX" } }]

logger.doc:name: Log Active Run Lock Acquired
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_RUN_LOCK_ACQUIRED", runId: vars.runId, triggerType: vars.triggerType, sourceFilePath: vars.sourceFilePath, lockKey: Mule::p("lock.activeKey"), runStatus: vars.runStatus }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/java
var fileDate = (vars.businessDate default "UNKNOWN_DATE") as String
--- "inventory_rejected_" ++ fileDate ++ ".csv.part"

%dw 2.0 output application/java
var fileDate = (vars.businessDate default "UNKNOWN_DATE") as String
var fileName = "inventory_rejected_" ++ fileDate ++ ".csv.part"
var stagingDirectory = ( vars.rejectedStagingDirectory default "C:/mule_files/process/records/rejected" ) as String
--- stagingDirectory ++ "/" ++ fileName

set-variable.doc:name: Check Rejection File Exists
set-variable.value: #[!isEmpty( (vars.existingRejectedFiles default []) filter ((fileEntry) -> ((fileEntry.attributes.fileName default "") as String) == ((vars.rejectionFileName default "") as String) ) )]

file:write.doc:name: Append Rejected Records
file:write.file:content:
#[%dw 2.0 output application/octet-stream
var rejectedRows = payload map ((record) -> { SKU: record.data.SKU default "", StoreId: record.data.StoreId default "", Type: record.data.Type default "", Quantity: record.data.Quantity default "", Timestamp: record.data.Timestamp default "", ValidationReason: (record.validation.reasons default []) joinBy "; " })
--- write( rejectedRows, "application/csv", { header: not (vars.rejectionFileExists default false), separator: ",", quoteValues: true, lineSeparator: "\n" } )]

logger.doc:name: Log Batch Completion
logger.message:
#[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_BATCH_COMPLETED",
totalRecordsLoaded: vars.batchResult.loadedRecords default 0,
technicallyProcessedRecords: vars.batchResult.successfulRecords default 0,
technicallyFailedRecords: vars.batchResult.failedRecords default 0 }]

flow-ref.doc:name: Move Failed Source File to Error
flow-ref.name: move-source-to-error-subflow

os:remove.doc:name: Release Active Run Lock After Failure

logger.doc:name: Log Active Run Lock Released
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_RUN_LOCK_RELEASED", runId: vars.runId default "UNKNOWN_RUN", runStatus: vars.runStatus default "FAILED", lockKey: Mule::p("lock.activeKey") }]

on-error-continue.doc:name: Ignore Missing Lock After Batch Failure

set-variable.doc:name: Set Batch Failure Notification Error Type
Set Batch Failure Notification Description
set-variable.value: #["One or more records failed because of technical processing errors. " ++ "Technically failed records: " ++ ( (vars.batchResult.failedRecords default 0) as String )]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise Batch Technical Failure
raise-error.description: One or more records failed because of technical processing errors

logger.doc:name: Log Duplicate Processing Stopped
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_DUPLICATE_PROCESSING_STOPPED", runId: vars.runId default "UNKNOWN_RUN", sourceFileName: vars.expectedSourceFileName default "UNKNOWN_FILE", duplicateFile: vars.duplicateFile default false, runStatus: vars.runStatus default "DUPLICATE_FILE" }]

logger.doc:name: Log Run Skipped
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_RUN_SKIPPED", runId: vars.runId, triggerType: vars.triggerType, sourceFilePath: vars.sourceFilePath, runStatus: vars.runStatus, reason: "Another inventory execution currently holds the active-run lock." }]

logger.doc:name: Log Missing Source File
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_SOURCE_FILE_MISSING", triggerType: vars.triggerType, runId: vars.runId, expectedSourceFilePath: vars.sourceFilePath, expectedSourceFileName: vars.expectedSourceFileName, runStatus: vars.runStatus, checkedAt: (now() >> "Asia/Kolkata") as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX" }, message: "The expected inventory source file was not found. Batch processing was not started." }]

logger.doc:name: Log Manual Missing Source Notification Skipped
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_MISSING_SOURCE_EMAIL_SKIPPED", runId: vars.runId default "UNKNOWN_RUN", triggerType: vars.triggerType default "UNKNOWN_TRIGGER", sourceFilePath: vars.sourceFilePath default "UNKNOWN_SOURCE", reason: "Missing-source email is sent only for Scheduler executions." }]

flow-ref.doc:name: Move Claimed Source File to Error
flow-ref.name: move-source-to-error-subflow

os:remove.doc:name: Release Active Run Lock After Processing Failure

logger.doc:name: Log No Lock Cleanup Required
logger.message: No active-run lock was acquired by this execution.

logger.doc:name: Log Inventory Processing Failure
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_PROCESSING_FAILED", runId: vars.runId default "UNKNOWN_RUN", triggerType: vars.triggerType default "UNKNOWN_TRIGGER", sourceFilePath: vars.sourceFilePath default "UNKNOWN_SOURCE", errorType: (error.errorType.identifier default "UNKNOWN") as String, errorDescription: error.description default "Inventory processing failed" }]
